verdict.rationale: Evidence focuses on MCP tool-calling where an agent invokes tools live on behalf of a user (auth, transport, SDKs), not on scheduled or event-driven automations that run without an active agent session. One item mentions 'triggers' for an app (openai.md) hinting at event-driven capability, but this isn't developed into a clear autonomous background-automation story for Pipedream MCP specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/triggered workflows running unattended via MCP, evidence of persistent background execution, independent confirmation of autonomous runs.
